districtFact: VBCPS publishes a 180-day calendar with four grading periods. Its 2026-2027 PDF separately identifies districtwide adjusted dismissal on the last student day, high-school adjusted-dismissal dates, and designated make-up dates that are used only if the superintendent activates them after a closure.

about.title: How to Read the VBCPS Calendar
about.content: The year-at-a-glance PDF distinguishes school holidays, student-free staff days, adjusted-dismissal dates, grading periods, and designated make-up dates. The four grading periods end October 30, January 22, April 8, and June 11 in 2026-2027; only June 11 is identified as a districtwide adjusted-dismissal day.

about.title: Support for Military-Connected Students
about.content: VBCPS says approximately 25 percent of its students are active-duty military dependents. The division employs two full-time military school counselors who support academic transitions, deployments, military power-of-attorney questions, and post-secondary planning.

planningTips.title: What VBCPS Families Should Confirm
content: Use the full December 21-January 1 Winter Break range when planning childcare; students return Monday, January 4, 2027.
Treat November 2, January 25, and April 9 as student-free staff days unless VBCPS announces that one will be used as a make-up day.
Check the live VBCPS calendar and official messages after weather or emergency closures because the superintendent determines make-up days.
